rules.title: OBBBA 'prohibited foreign entity' material-assistance rules (45X, 48E)
rules.date_label: Applies to components sold after 31 Dec 2025
rules.summary: Tax credits for battery components limit how much of the product's direct material cost may come from prohibited foreign entities. The share is measured by a material assistance cost ratio (MACR); IRS Notice 2026-15 (12 Feb 2026) gave interim guidance.
rules.why_it_matters: This is a cost-weighted rule, so it needs BOM cost by supplier: exactly the join PartLink does.
rules.source: IRS Notice 2026-15; EY Tax News (17 Feb 2026)
rules.workaround: Compute the ratio per product, and shift material to non-prohibited suppliers where it falls short.

rules.title: Treasury safe-harbor tables for the MACR due
rules.summary: The law requires Treasury to issue safe-harbor tables, letting taxpayers estimate prohibited-foreign-entity cost shares.
rules.why_it_matters: Tables change how easily you can show compliance.
rules.workaround: Plan to re-run the ratio when tables publish.

rules.title: EU Batteries Regulation: digital battery passport
rules.summary: EV batteries, light-means-of-transport batteries and industrial batteries above 2 kWh need a digital passport with composition and footprint data.
rules.why_it_matters: Passport data comes from the supplier chain, so you need part-to-supplier traceability for each battery.
rules.workaround: Start collecting supplier composition data now.

rules.title: EU Batteries Regulation: supply-chain due diligence
rules.summary: Due-diligence policies for cobalt, lithium, nickel and natural graphite. Companies under EUR 40M net turnover are exempt under conditions.
rules.why_it_matters: Needs supplier mapping several tiers deep.
rules.workaround: Map suppliers of the four materials.
